reviews.x: These are good for sleeping in to keep your hair in place.  2 for that price was great. I like how it stays on my head all night.

reviews.t: It does hold my hair in place!
reviews.x: This cap is very pretty and colorful. I wish it would have come in size X-large because it’s a little too snug, but it will loosen over time. It does hold my hair in place though. I would buy again!

I bought this set of sleep caps on the recommendation of one of my favorite YouTubers. It may have worked for her, but hasn't for me.  I have very fine hair that's prone to tangle, even with using silk pillowcases. I thought the sleep cap(s) would help, but that hasn't been the case at all. Still waking up with major bed head. Bummer!  Although the cap is comfortable, I was very disappointed that one of the caps came straight out of the package with 2 small rips in it. I haven't used it for fear

Wtfffff!!! These things bleeed allll overrrr my sheeeets! I'm sooo mad! And my sheets are not cheap! Luckily they were white I tried bleaching it out. But it was still there!!!!! Soo what kinda die y'all use. I'm sure if your hair is blond you're gonna wake up with blue hair! I want my money backkkk.

These are perfect in every way. They are comfortable and cool. Never did I think I would find a bonnet that actually stays on throughout the night but it does. Shipping was fast came before it was supposed to I would definitely order for this vendor again
Stays on my head all night! Very soft and pretty colors!

reviews.t: Really tight / Great for a child
reviews.x: Never thought I had a big head.. I think these are better for children and others with small heads.  I'm average with shoulder length curly, curly hair and the elastic band was uncomfortable. I'm stretching the elastic between 2 metal posts for a few days to see if that loosens it up. The cap part is soft and well packaged, but if it's still too tight, they are gonna be given to my grands.

reviews.t: You get what you pay for
reviews.x: It doesn’t stay on throughout the night. At first it was very tight and gave me a headache. Now, after wearing it for only a few night, it slips around before I ever lay down.
EDGES BEWARE! My edges thinned out when wearing these too much. And when my hair was freshly pressed it slipped off so easy. Other than that it served its purpose perfectly.
It’s a little bit tight but it is quality material and stretches, just has a strong grip. After the first night it loosened a bit, but the first night gave me a headache

reviews.t: Band too tight, slippery side is on the outside.
reviews.x: The satin, slippery finish should be on the inside (to protect curls).  The band is way too tight.  I tried it a few nights but the band gave me a headache.
Fits perfectly stays on all night.  It is not too tight to cause any discomfort and the material feels like silk.  Just what i was looking for to sleep.
These have a strong elastic band but the size is too small for my head. Still stretching them out on a chair.

reviews.t: Elastic band much too tight and small and bought it much too small squashes hair
reviews.x: Elastic band much too tight and small and bought it much too small squashes hair

reviews.t: Too big for my extra small head
reviews.x: The material is great. So is the wide band. I like that there are no ties or overlapping fabric on the side or back of the head where I'd lay on it.  The problem is that the elastic is too big for my head and slips down over my eyes and nose. I have a particularly small head, and hats are usually too big. It didn't occur to me that this might be, too, since it's elastic, but alas, here we are. The circumference of the cap is just over 22 inches, and my head is just under 22. It's enough of a dif

reviews.t: The cap's band is too tight and gave me a headache
reviews.x: I thought this would be a good solution for my hair, since I toss and turn all night. I also wear a sleep mask and the strap on the mask rubs on my hair. I bought this product hoping I could stop the harsh rubbing my hair takes from the mask and the tossing and turning. Instead, I woke up with a horrible headache in the areas around the cap's band. There is not a lot of give in the cap's band at all. i guess my head is too big. One size does not fit all.

These are lightweight and very pretty nightcaps. However, they don’t stay in place! At first the elastic felt too tight. Then the elastic stretched out quickly. Now, neither of two the caps will stay in place. By the time I wake up in the morning, the nightcap completely covers my eyebrows. I have sensitive skin and have noticed that my forehead has broken out since the nightcap started slipping.

I had to return the bonnet because it did not stay on my head. I had to fuss with it throughout the night and did not sleep well,  Of course, I woke up with frizzy hair.  I have fine  short curly  2c/3a hair. Overall, it felt comfortable, perhaps it was because my head was too small, so I never felt any kind of pressure from the elastic headband.

I didn’t want to leave a negative review but could not find a place to contact the seller. I have a small head but big hair. The cap does not stay in place, it slides down over my eyes. The band is sturdy but not in a good way, the only way to keep the bonnet off my eyes is to place the band over my ears and with the hardness of it is painful.

Love these sleep caps. My daughter never keeps a cap on at night, but when I gave her this one she loved it so much and she wears it every night. It was a little tight at first but now it's perfect. My daughter didn't have a problem with tightness. We loved them so much I ordered two more.

I love these caps. they are nice and silky and hold all my curly hair quite well. The band fits just right, is not too loose or too tight. It stayed on my head till morning even though Im a tosser in my sleep. this and a satin pillow has helped my hair so much.

reviews.t: Sturdy fit...won't come off during sleep
reviews.x: Love them they are a little snug because the elasticity is very rigid but you can work around yet based on how you wear it. I try to not have it too close  to my ears or on my ears and that fit is much better. These serve their purpose. I really can't complain.

The headband on these sleep caps are a little tight for me and my head is on the small side. Nevertheless, the colors did not fade or bleed. I washed before wearing and believe the band may have tightened up some so it might release or stretch out.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the caps stay on all night and hold hair in place.
Several reviewers find the elastic band too tight, sometimes causing headaches or being better suited to children/small heads.
Reviewers frequently praise the soft material and pretty, colorful appearance.
A few reviewers report the cap slipping off during the night, especially with freshly pressed hair.
One reviewer reports the color bleeding and ruining sheets.
